posts.title: How I discovered my TV's wifi and bluetooth chip is fried
posts.description: My Mi TV was stuck on the PatchWall screen for a year. I connected it over ethernet, enabled ADB and let Claude Code dig in. It confirmed the WiFi and Bluetooth chip is dead.
